title: Vibrant Spicy Jamaican Sea Bass Skewers
description: A spicy and chewy Jamaican dish featuring sea bass, pickle, and nostalgic flavors, served on a hot stone plate, ovo-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a blender, combine scotch bonnet peppers, onion, garlic, thyme, and allspice, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the sea bass cubes, blended pepper mixture, and pickle relish, and toss to coat.
Thread the sea bass mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the skewers on a hot stone plate, garnished with additional thyme and scotch bonnet peppers if desired.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
